364|2|6|700.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
364|2|6|700.evidence: 21/37 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

364|2|6|700.text: Both axles lock under hard braking: brake pressure too high overall — bring it down to the knee.
364|2|6|700.evidence: median deficit F 0.58 / R 0.39; 7/11 stops locked both

364|2|6|700.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
364|2|6|700.evidence: 507 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

364|2|6|700.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
364|2|6|700.evidence: median peak rear slip 2.70; 1/1 launches spun

364|2|6|700.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.29) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
